rules.title: Nonprofit hospitals: free to 200% FPL, discounts to 400%
rules.plain: Oregon nonprofit hospitals must cut your costs 100% if your household income is at or under 200% of the poverty line, and by at least 75%, 50% or 25% up to 400%.
rules.quote: For a patient whose household income is not more than 200 percent of the federal poverty guidelines, by 100 percent
rules.notes: Applies to nonprofit hospitals and their nonprofit affiliated clinics, for medically necessary services. The policy may not require applying for Medicaid first (442.614(2)).

rules.title: Hospitals must screen some patients
rules.short: The hospital must screen you for help if you're uninsured, on Medicaid, or owe more than $500
rules.plain: Oregon hospitals must screen you for financial assistance if you're uninsured, on the state Medicaid program, or owe the hospital more than $500.
rules.quote: shall screen a patient for presumptive eligibility for financial assistance if the patient

rules.title: Approval lasts nine months
rules.short: Once approved, you stay eligible for nine months
rules.plain: Once a hospital approves you based on your documents, you stay eligible for nine months without reapplying.
rules.quote: the patient’s eligibility for financial assistance continues for nine months following the hospital’s determination

rules.title: Collections pause during an appeal
rules.short: Collections stop while you appeal a denial
rules.plain: If you appeal a denial of financial assistance, the hospital must suspend collections while the appeal is pending.
rules.quote: the hospital must suspend all collection activities
